current_evidence.meaning: OpenClaw plugin surface for importing Hermes state.

gates: No unbounded version ladder: work is closed by final fusion gates, not by V1.2/V1.3 naming.
No final claim until every Hermes capability is inventoried, mapped, tested, or explicitly superseded.
No adapter-only claim: migration and compatibility surfaces must be promoted or bounded.
No unsafe autonomy: destructive, external, secret, release, and final-seal actions remain approval-gated.
No release/tag mutation in this audit step.

objective.intent: Create one final deliverable system that preserves OpenClaw capabilities, preserves Hermes capabilities, and adds unified capabilities that exceed either source system alone.
objective.name: OpenClaw-Hermes Final Fusion
not_the_goal: Do not continue an unbounded V1.2/V1.3 version ladder.
Do not freeze the current state as final before fusion gaps are closed.
Do not treat migration/adaptation as full fusion without runtime evidence.

summary.next_action: Build the source-anchored capability inventory for OpenClaw and Hermes.

done_when: Every capability has a source anchor, OpenClaw owner, test surface, and evidence path.
No Hermes capability is classified only by narrative claim.
workstreams.goal: Build a source-anchored inventory for every OpenClaw and Hermes capability.
workstreams.name: Capability inventory and parity proof

done_when: Adapter-only Hermes capabilities are either promoted, explicitly replaced by stronger OpenClaw-native behavior, or rejected with evidence.
The migrate-hermes plugin is a bridge, not the final proof of fusion.
workstreams.goal: Promote Hermes behavior from migration/adapter surfaces into first-class OpenClaw runtime capabilities.
workstreams.name: Hermes capability promotion

done_when: StateMachine, EventLedger, PolicyEngine, ToolGateway, Supervisor, and final acceptance share one coherent contract.
Approval boundaries are machine-checkable and human-readable.
workstreams.goal: Unify policy, approvals, state progression, event ledger, and final acceptance into one governed runtime.
workstreams.name: Unified governance kernel

done_when: Memory and skill artifacts carry source, purpose, expiry, audit, promotion, and rollback metadata.
Hermes-origin knowledge can be imported, validated, promoted, and reverted.
workstreams.goal: Fuse persistent memory, skill lifecycle, migration history, and rollback rules into a durable intelligence layer.
workstreams.name: Memory, skill, and knowledge lifecycle

done_when: Interruptions, missing state, missing artifacts, inconsistent ledgers, and retry loops have bounded recovery paths.
Autonomy never crosses destructive, external, secret, release, or final-seal approval gates.
workstreams.goal: Combine Hermes-style continuity with OpenClaw safety into bounded autonomous execution.
workstreams.name: Recovery and autonomous execution

done_when: Fresh install, upgrade, smoke, package acceptance, and core e2e workflows are reproducible.
A third party can run the fused system without private project memory.
workstreams.goal: Make the fused system installable, runnable, observable, and handoff-ready.
workstreams.name: Installable and operable product

done_when: The system can prove evidence-driven autonomous progress across sessions.
The system can supervise agent work, enforce policy, recover state, and emit acceptance evidence as one loop.
The beyond-both claims are covered by executable tests or replayable evidence.
workstreams.goal: Deliver explicit capabilities that are only possible after fusion.
workstreams.name: Beyond-both-system capabilities
